subject: fiddler crab
title: A Fiddler Crab's Claw Is Up to 65% of Its Body Weight

scenes.text: One crab carries a claw that's heavier than the rest of him.
As a male fiddler crab grows, his big claw can reach 65% of his total body weight.
He waves it up and down to impress females and scare off rivals.
But it slows him down. When researchers made crabs drop the claw, most ran almost a third faster.
He carries the burden on purpose. In the crab world, the biggest weight wins the biggest crowd.
